content.name: Priya Lockwood
content.title: Graduate Data Analyst
content.summary: Mathematics with Statistics graduate (First) in my first full-time analyst role at a Yorkshire building society, after a year-long placement in a water utility's performance team. Comfortable with SQL, Power BI and R, and happiest when a report I built replaces a manual process. My placement dashboard on leak response times is still used by the operations team.

experience.title: Graduate Data Analyst
bullets: Rebuilt the weekly mortgage pipeline report in Power BI, replacing a 30-tab spreadsheet and saving the lending team about 4 hours every Monday.
Wrote SQL checks that catch duplicate and incomplete savings applications before month end, reducing manual corrections by roughly a quarter.
Support two senior analysts on the member retention model by preparing and documenting the data extracts used for each monthly refresh.

experience.title: Placement Data Analyst (industrial year)
bullets: Created a leak response dashboard covering 1,800 monthly jobs, which the operations manager adopted for daily stand-ups.
Cleaned five years of customer contact data in R and spotted that 14% of complaints were repeat contacts about the same fault.
Presented findings on weekend call-out delays to a panel of six managers, leading to a trial of an extra standby crew.

education.degree: BSc (Hons) Mathematics with Statistics, First Class
education.details: Sandwich degree with industrial placement year. Dissertation: forecasting hospital A&E attendances with time-series models.

courses.name: PL-300: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst

achievements.title: Best placement project, School of Mathematics
achievements.detail: Awarded for the leak response dashboard and the write-up of its impact on call-out planning (2024).

achievements.title: Student society treasurer
